from __future__ import annotations
import json
from pathlib import Path
P=Path("knowledge/candidates/protocols/MANUAL-SCOUT-HENGELTJES-20260924-shadow-v1.json")
C=Path("knowledge/candidates/MANUAL-SCOUT-HENGELTJES-20260924.json")
def fill(q,size,events,seq=True,reconn=True,restart=False):
    if restart:return("UNPROVEN_RESTART",0)
    if not seq or not reconn:return("UNPROVEN_FILL",0)
    x=0
    for e in events:
        if e["type"]=="execution": x+=int(e["qty"])
        elif e["type"] in ("cancel","touch"): pass
        else:return("UNPROVEN_FILL",0)
    y=max(0,x-q); return(("PROVEN_FILL" if y else "UNFILLED"),min(size,y))
def order(p,r):
    forbidden={"final_settlement","settlement_outcome","markout_10","markout_30","markout_60","markout_120"}
    assert not forbidden.intersection(r)
    g=p["virtual_order_grid"]; price=int(r["maker_bid_cents"]); t=int(r["t_minus_minutes"]); size=int(r.get("size_contracts",g["size_contracts"]))
    assert price in g["maker_bid_cents"] and t in g["t_minus_minutes"] and size==g["size_contracts"]
    return(r["side"],price,t,size)
def one(run_no):
    p=json.loads(P.read_text()); c=json.loads(C.read_text())
    assert p["schema"]=="PVA_PROSPECTIVE_SHADOW_PROTOCOL_V1" and p["status"]=="PREREGISTERED_PENDING_DEATHCHECKS"
    assert c["candidate_id"]==p["candidate_id"] and c["decision"]=="UNPROVEN" and c["director_trace"]["economic_conclusion"]=="NO_PROVEN_EDGE"
    assert fill(10,5,[{"type":"touch"}])==("UNFILLED",0)
    assert fill(10,5,[{"type":"cancel","qty":50}])==("UNFILLED",0)
    assert fill(10,5,[{"type":"execution","qty":12}])==("PROVEN_FILL",2)
    assert fill(10,5,[{"type":"execution","qty":99}],seq=False)[0]=="UNPROVEN_FILL"
    assert fill(10,5,[{"type":"execution","qty":99}],reconn=False)[0]=="UNPROVEN_FILL"
    assert fill(10,5,[{"type":"execution","qty":99}],restart=True)[0]=="UNPROVEN_RESTART"
    print("DC1_FALSE_POSITIVE_FILL=PASS")
    base={"side":"NO","maker_bid_cents":89,"t_minus_minutes":10,"size_contracts":5}; assert order(p,dict(base))==order(p,dict(base))
    try: order(p,{**base,"final_settlement":"NO"}); raise AssertionError("hindsight accepted")
    except AssertionError as e:
        if str(e)=="hindsight accepted": raise
    assert p["point_in_time_evidence"]["post_close_information_for_order_decision_forbidden"] is True
    assert p["point_in_time_evidence"]["later_revision_backfill_for_preclose_decision_forbidden"] is True
    print("DC2_NO_HINDSIGHT=PASS")
    for k in ("live_trading","order_placement","cancel_or_amend","wallet_actions","paid_actions","openai_api","cloud_or_vps"): assert p["safety"][k] is False
    for k in ("live_trading","paid_actions","wallet_actions","openai_api"): assert c[k] is False
    assert p["virtual_order_grid"]["passive_only"] is True and p["virtual_order_grid"]["marketable_orders_forbidden"] is True
    print("DC3_NO_LIVE_OR_COST_PATH=PASS")
    m=p["historical_regression_only"]["miami_case"]; cost=5*.89; profit=round(5-cost,2); roi=round(profit/cost*100,2)
    assert round(cost,2)==round(m["expected_cost_usd"],2) and profit==round(m["expected_profit_usd"],2) and roi==round(m["expected_roi_pct"],2)
    assert "never validation evidence" in m["role"]; print("MIAMI_REGRESSION=PASS")
    f=[{"type":"execution","qty":9},{"type":"cancel","qty":100},{"type":"execution","qty":4}]
    assert fill(10,5,f)==("PROVEN_FILL",3) and fill(10,5,f,seq=False)[0]=="UNPROVEN_FILL" and fill(10,5,f,reconn=False)[0]=="UNPROVEN_FILL" and fill(10,5,f,restart=True)[0]=="UNPROVEN_RESTART"
    print("SEQUENCE_RECONNECT_RESTART_FIXTURES=PASS")
    print("READ_ONLY_NO_COST_GUARD=PASS")
    print(f"CLEAN_RUN_{run_no}=PASS")
for i in range(1,4): one(i)
print("HENGELTJE_THREE_CLEAN_RUNS_E012=PASS")
print("HENGELTJE_DEATHCHECKS_E012=PASS")
print("ACTIVATION_STATUS=NOT_ACTIVATED_PRE_REVIEW")

notes: Preregistered deterministic Hengeltje deathchecks and three clean no-live/no-cost fixture runs. No prospective activation. NO_PROVEN_EDGE.
